ValidationRule.description: DIR-869: Locks a Customer Approved Quote. Exempts: transition to Cancelled, IsSyncing changes, and RES_Reservation_Start_Date__c/ContractId (legitimately stamped by RES_OpportunityStageUpdateValidation on Reservation).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Residential_Sales", NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Customer Approved"), NOT(ISCHANGED(IsSyncing)), NOT(ISCHANGED(RES_Reservation_Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(ContractId)), NOT( AND(ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Cancelled")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote has been Customer Approved and is locked. It can no longer be edited, except to cancel it.
